title: ecc-hypercube: Reed–Muller and Hypercube GLDPC codes on the hypercube
description:
Dependency-free Rust encoding and decoding of Reed–Muller codes on the hypercube: the 2013 hypercube majority-logic decoder (Reed's 1954 algorithm) with bit-packed voting, recursive soft-decision list decoding, and automorphism-ensemble decoding with maximum-likelihood certificates for early stopping, and generalized LDPC codes built from extended-Hamming hypercube checks with exact Hartmann–Rudolph component decoding.

Dual-licensed under MIT OR Apache-2.0; both license texts are included in the archive.
